'''Kayderr''' was a friend of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] who was killed by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] sent by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MercenaryTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Kayderr]]
In ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', Kayderr's gender, species, and appearance would fluctuate after each quest. The quest dialogue did not specify any physical aspects of Kayderr.

Though not mentioned in the quest dialogue, examining Kayderr revealed Kayderr to be a mercenary.
